title: Welfare-Enhancing Mechanism Design for Agent Ecosystems
abstract: arXiv:2611.33627v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The emerging Agentic Web forms a multi-agent ecosystem: a decentralized service market where the user agent selects which content agents to query from their submitted profiles, before seeing any documents. Profiles therefore become a new target of optimization. Existing Generative Engine Optimization studies how a single supplier rewrites documents the engine can already retrieve, to improve their citation. In the Agentic Web, multiple content agents optimize profiles to compete for limited opportunities to deliver documents. To study this repeated interaction, we build WildRegistry, a simulation framework and benchmark based on a real agentic-search request stream, and model it as a dynamic game under private monitoring. Long-horizon experiments show that this competition lowers website-selection quality and settles at a harmful stable point, which our empirical criterion identifies as an approximate rewriting equilibrium. We therefor

translated_title: 面向智能体生态系统的福利增进型机制设计
translated_abstract: 新兴的智能体网络形成了一个多智能体生态系统：一个去中心化的服务市场，其中用户智能体在看到任何文档之前，根据内容智能体提交的档案来选择要查询哪些内容智能体。因此，档案成为优化的新目标。现有的生成式引擎优化研究的是单一供应商如何重写引擎已可检索的文档以提升其被引用率，而在智能体网络中，多个内容智能体通过优化档案来竞争有限的文档交付机会。为了研究这种重复交互，我们构建了WildRegistry——一个基于真实智能体搜索请求流的模拟框架与基准，并将其建模为私有监测下的动态博弈。长期实验表明，这种竞争降低了网站选择质量，并最终收敛于一个有害的稳定点，我们的实证标准将其识别为近似重写均衡。因此（摘要在此处截断，据标题推断论文提出了增进社会福利的机制设计方案）。
tldr: 该论文构建了WildRegistry模拟框架，将智能体网络中多个内容智能体优化档案、竞争用户查询机会的重复交互建模为私有监测下的动态博弈，发现这种竞争会降低网站选择质量并陷入有害的近似重写均衡，进而提出福利增进型机制设计来改善多智能体生态系统。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces WildRegistry, a simulation framework modeling the repeated competition among content agents optimizing profiles in the Agentic Web as a dynamic game under private monitoring, shows that such competition degrades website-selection quality and settles at a harmful approximate rewriting equilibrium, and proposes welfare-enhancing mechanism design for multi-agent ecosystems.
